brief:
The British government is expanding measures against Israeli settlement in the occupied West Bank, the Shehab Wire reported. Officials are exploring options that could extend beyond current sanctions on settlers and related entities to include restrictions on trade activities connected to settlement expansion.

The potential escalation marks a shift in Britain's approach to West Bank settlement policy. The government has signaled willingness to move past existing punitive measures targeting individual settlers and their organizations, instead considering economic restrictions that would affect broader commercial activity linked to the settlements. Details of any forthcoming sanctions remain under discussion within government circles.
